local pg=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- [실제 입력 처리] 포 사격 클릭이 해전 판정까지 도달했는지(발사·사거리 밖·선측 불일치) 확인한다.

local pg=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local g=assert(pg:FindFirstChild("BattleGui"),"NAVAL_GUI_MISSING")
-- [함선별 특화 기술] 기함마다 둘째 기술이 다르다(접현 돌진·철벽 방어·회피 기동·일제사격). 포 사격이 아닌 기술 버튼을 찾아 누른다.
local b
for _,d in g:GetDescendants() do
 if d:IsA("GuiButton") and string.sub(d.Name,1,11)=="NavalSkill_" and d.Name~="NavalSkill_fire" then b=d break end
end
assert(b and b.Visible and b.AbsoluteSize.X>0,"NAVAL_SKILL_BUTTON_MISSING:special")
workspace:SetAttribute("QANavalSpecial",string.sub(b.Name,12))
workspace:SetAttribute("QANavalUsedBefore",g:GetAttribute("NavalSkillsUsed") or 0)
g:SetAttribute("NavalSkillResult",nil)
return string.format("%d,%d CLICK=naval_special_%s",math.floor(b.AbsolutePosition.X+b.AbsoluteSize.X/2),math.floor(b.AbsolutePosition.Y+b.AbsoluteSize.Y/2),string.sub(b.Name,12))

local pg=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local g=assert(pg:FindFirstChild("BattleGui"),"NAVAL_GUI_MISSING")
local id=tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("QANavalSpecial"))
local r=g:GetAttribute("NavalSkillResult")
local used=g:GetAttribute("NavalSkillsUsed") or 0
assert(r==id..":ok" and used>(workspace:GetAttribute("QANavalUsedBefore") or 0),"NAVAL_SPECIAL_NOT_ACTIVATED:"..id..":"..tostring(r))
return "NAVAL_SPECIAL_PASS "..id.." used="..used

local pg=game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local g=assert(pg:FindFirstChild("BattleGui"),"NAVAL_GUI_MISSING")
-- [실제 교전] 전투 진행 뒤 양측 선체가 실제 피해로 변해야 한다(기존 160/150 시작).
local foe,me=g:GetAttribute("NavalFoeHull"),g:GetAttribute("NavalMeHull")
assert((foe and foe<150) or (me and me<160),"NAVAL_NO_HULL_CHANGE:foe="..tostring(foe).." me="..tostring(me))
return string.format("NAVAL_EXCHANGE_PASS foe=%s me=%s skills=%s",tostring(foe),tostring(me),tostring(g:GetAttribute("NavalSkillsUsed")))
